history.summary: A freehold 1,389 sqft 3BR at $2.288M in Onan Suites, D15 Joo Chiat/Eunos area, 1.39km from Eunos MRT. Freehold and a reasonable $1,647 PSF (~2% under median) are positives, but the appreciation rate rests on just 5 URA transactions — essentially no statistical basis — and the project is a small, MRT-distant boutique.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold in a desirable D15 Joo Chiat enclave at $1,647 PSF (~2% below the $1,683 median) and a workable $2.288M quantum are the case for it. But the appreciation data is effectively unusable — 3.3%/yr on only 5 transactions is noise, not a trend — and the development is a small boutique 1.39km/17min from Eunos MRT, so liquidity is shallow and the location lacks transit pull. A 1,389 sqft freehold 3BR has own-stay charm but for a 5-7yr investment hold the thin data and weak connectivity keep this firmly Neutral, leaning cautious.
red_flags: Only 5 URA txns — appreciation rate is statistically meaningless
Small boutique development — shallow resale liquidity
1.39km / 17min to Eunos MRT — poor transit access weakens rental and resale
catalysts: Freehold tenure in D15 Joo Chiat/Katong lifestyle enclave
Generous 1,389 sqft layout appeals to own-stay/family buyers on resale
